technology.title: Inside the engine
technology.subtitle: Our trading system analyzes market trends, signals, and risk to find the best opportunities. It adapts to changing conditions automatically.

trend.title: Multi-Timeframe Trend Analysis
trend.description: Uses ROC (Rate of Change) and EMA indicators to identify the overall trend direction and strength across different timeframes.

benefits.1: Analyzes trends across multiple timeframes simultaneously (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d)
benefits.2: Uses Rate of Change (ROC) to measure momentum strength and direction
benefits.3: Exponential Moving Averages (EMA) identify primary trend direction
benefits.4: Filters out market noise while preserving significant trend movements
benefits.5: Provides trend strength scoring from 0-100 for position confidence

trend.alert: Our trend analysis engine examines price movements across multiple timeframes to identify the dominant market direction, filtering out short-term noise while capturing significant trend changes.

signals.title: OBOS Signals
signals.description: Detects overbought/oversold conditions using RSI and pivot points to find potential entry opportunities when momentum diverges from price.

benefits.1: RSI divergence detection identifies momentum shifts before price confirms
benefits.2: Pivot point analysis finds key support/resistance levels automatically
benefits.3: Overbought (>70 RSI) and oversold (<30 RSI) condition monitoring
benefits.4: Volume-price divergence analysis for signal confirmation
benefits.5: Multi-indicator convergence increases signal reliability to 78%

signals.alert: Advanced signal detection combines RSI, pivot points, and volume analysis to identify high-probability entry points when momentum diverges from price direction.

confirm.title: HTF Confirmation
confirm.description: Requires higher timeframe alignment before entering trades, reducing false signals and improving accuracy.

benefits.1: Requires 4-hour and daily timeframe alignment before execution
benefits.2: Reduces false signal rate by 65% compared to single timeframe
benefits.3: Eliminates trades against the broader market trend
benefits.4: Provides confidence scoring based on timeframe alignment
benefits.5: Prevents entries during uncertain or choppy market conditions

confirm.alert: Higher timeframe confirmation ensures trades align with the broader market structure, dramatically reducing false signals and improving overall accuracy.

risk.title: Risk Management
risk.description: Implements trailing stops and take-profit levels to lock in gains while protecting against downside risk.

benefits.1: Dynamic trailing stops adjust based on market volatility (ATR-based)
benefits.2: Take-profit levels set at 2:1 reward-to-risk minimum ratios
benefits.3: Position sizing adjusts based on win rate and volatility
benefits.4: Maximum drawdown protection with circuit breakers

risk.alert: Sophisticated risk management system uses trailing stops, take-profit optimization, and dynamic position sizing to protect capital while maximizing returns.

size.title: Position Sizing
size.description: Uses percentage-based position sizing to maintain consistent risk exposure across different trade sizes.

benefits.1: Percentage-based sizing maintains consistent risk exposure
benefits.2: Volatility-adjusted sizing reduces exposure in turbulent markets
benefits.3: Win rate optimization adjusts size based on recent performance

size.alert: Position sizing algorithm ensures optimal capital allocation across different market conditions and strategy performance levels.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about Zillions
faq.a1: No. Zillions is built so anyone can participate. The engine adapts to markets for you.
faq.a2: No - it's on‑chain and non‑custodial. You can track execution and history transparently.
faq.a3: No. Markets involve risk. The system aims to grow capital by aligning to dominant regimes, but losses are possible.
faq.q4: What chains and assets will you support?
faq.a4: We'll announce supported chains and assets to waitlisters first.
faq.a5: Zillions is an AI-powered, on-chain crypto trading platform that uses a meta-trading engine to adapt to market conditions automatically. It helps everyday people participate in markets without needing trading expertise.
faq.q6: How does Zillions differ from other trading bots?
faq.a6: Unlike traditional bots with fixed strategies, Zillions uses a meta-trading engine that detects and adapts to the currently dominant market regime (momentum, mean-reversion, etc.) in real-time. It's on-chain, transparent, and designed for simplicity.
faq.q7: How does the AI/meta-trading engine work?
faq.a7: The engine analyzes multi-timeframe trends, signals, and confirmations using indicators like ROC, EMA, RSI, and pivot points. It automatically switches strategies based on market conditions, manages risk with trailing stops and position sizing, and executes trades on-chain.
faq.q8: What risk management features does Zillions have?
faq.a8: Zillions implements dynamic trailing stops, take-profit levels at 2:1 reward-to-risk ratios, volatility-adjusted position sizing, maximum drawdown protection, and regime-specific risk controls to protect capital during adverse market phases.
faq.a9: Zillions charges transparent, on-chain fees for vault funding and trading execution. Specific fee structures will be announced to waitlisters, but we aim for competitive rates compared to traditional trading platforms.
faq.a10: Performance varies with market conditions. The system aims to grow capital by aligning with dominant regimes, but crypto markets are volatile. Historical backtesting shows potential for consistent returns, but past performance doesn't guarantee future results.
faq.a11: Connect your non-custodial wallet, select a vault, and fund it with supported assets. Deposits are processed on-chain with full transparency and control remaining in your wallet.
faq.a12: Withdrawals can be initiated from your wallet dashboard. Funds are returned to your connected wallet on-chain, maintaining non-custodial control throughout the process.
faq.q13: How do I select trading strategies?
faq.a13: You don't need to select strategies manually. The meta-trading engine automatically detects and adapts to the best-performing regime. You can view strategy performance and backtest results in your dashboard.
faq.a14: Backtesting allows you to simulate strategies on historical data to analyze performance, risk metrics, and potential returns before live trading. Zillions provides tools to improve and optimize strategies based on backtest results.
faq.a15: Zillions is non-custodial - you maintain control of your funds at all times. All execution, history, and parameters are on-chain for full auditability. We implement multiple security measures, but crypto investments carry inherent risks.
faq.a16: Join the waitlist for early access. Once available, connect your wallet, complete verification, fund a vault with supported assets, and let the AI engine handle the trading automatically.
faq.a17: Zillions is currently in development. Join the waitlist to be among the first to access the platform when it launches. We'll provide updates and early access to waitlisters.
faq.q18: What if I have more questions?
faq.a18: Check our documentation or contact our support team. We're here to help you understand how Zillions can work for you.
